version_scheme: No published GitHub release; pin the official master branch head as the latest available upstream source snapshot.
coverage: GCC native gcovr target coverage with -fprofile-abs-path; omits the incompatible vendored Onvif/pugixml.gcda and .gcno metadata only; AFLNet helper bitmap kept separate.
build_configuration: CMake Debug, native GCC/G++, --coverage -fprofile-abs-path, ENABLE_SERVER=ON, ENABLE_OPENSSL=ON, ENABLE_API/PLAYER/HLS/RTPPROXY/SRT/SCTP/WEBRTC/TESTS=OFF; ENABLE_MP4=ON retains required libflv symbols while config disables MP4 runtime output; cmake --build -j2 --target MediaServer
